news.title: Preparation Begins for the Annual 2026 Divine Power Convention
news.author: Church Secretary
news.excerpt: The Church Council announces key dates, guest ministers, and prayer guidelines for our upcoming annual convention.
news.content:
We give all glory to Almighty God as we approach our landmark Annual Divine Power Convention at First Baptist Church Jobele.

Under the theme **"The Exceeding Greatness of His Power"**, this year's convention promises to be a life-transforming season of spiritual realignment, physical healing, and communal rejuvenation.

### Key Details:
- **Dates**: October 23rd – 25th, 2026
- **Venue**: Main Sanctuary, P. O. Box 184, Jobele, Oyo State
- **Ministers**: Senior Pastoral Team and invited guest ministers from across the Nigerian Baptist Convention.

All members and ministries are encouraged to join the 21-day prayer countdown starting next Monday. Let us come with expectant hearts!

news.title: Highlights from the September Jobele Community Welfare Outreach
news.author: Missions Committee
news.excerpt: Over 150 families in Jobele received relief supplies, medical consultations, and prayer as our outreach team took the Gospel to the streets.
news.content:
In obedience to the Great Commission and the commandment of love, First Baptist Church Jobele successfully carried out our monthly village and neighborhood outreach.

Our volunteer medical doctors and nurses ministered to seniors and nursing mothers, while the welfare team distributed bags of rice, grains, and toiletries. Over 30 individuals made first-time commitments to Christ.

Thank you to everyone who contributed through their prayers and designated missions giving!

news.title: Baptist Doctrine & Discipleship Class: New Cohort Enrolling
news.author: Christian Education Board
news.excerpt: New believers and those seeking believer's baptism or formal church membership are invited to enroll in our 6-week foundational class.
news.content:
Are you a new believer, newly relocated to Jobele, or desiring to deepen your understanding of Baptist heritage, biblical orthodoxy, and believer's baptism?

Registration is now open for the Autumn Discipleship Cohort. Classes will take place every Sunday morning before the main service.

Topics covered include:
- The Authority and Sufficiency of the Scriptures
- The Trinitarian God and the Work of the Cross
- Believer's Baptism by Immersion & The Lord's Supper
- Stewardship and The Local Church Mission
